note: 2024 TEST DATA WAS NOT USED FOR FEATURE SELECTION OR MODEL SELECTION.

imputation.method: SimpleImputer(strategy='median') fitted on TRAIN (2015-2021) only; statistic frozen and applied identically to validation and test
imputation.rationale: Structural season-boundary NaNs (1 per cell-season on June 1). None dropped; explicit train-only median imputation; same frozen statistic for val and test.

A.name: frozen_reference
A.description: exact Phase G D_full feature set, unchanged

F.name: selected_combination
F.rationale: Not constructed. Only Group B (temporal) demonstrated validation value, and only for revival. No evidence that combining multiple groups improves any target, so an over-complex F was avoided (H8.1).

onset.hyperparameters: two-state Markov P(y_t|y_{t-1}) from train; dseason==1 uses climatology
onset.rationale: No ML or representation (groups A-E) beat frozen persistence on validation (best ML B/xgb 0.00894). Keep frozen reference.

break.hyperparameters: two-state Markov P(y_t|y_{t-1}) from train; dseason==1 uses climatology
break.rationale: No ML or representation (groups A-E) beat frozen persistence on validation (best ML A/xgb 0.07870, B/xgb 0.07900). Keep frozen reference.

revival.preprocessing: SimpleImputer(median) train-only on th_rstd7, th_rstd14, sp_mean_lag1 + StandardScaler(train) for nothing (XGB no scaling)
revival.rationale: XGBoost + temporal (B) beats the frozen Phase G XGBoost reference on validation (Brier 0.01226->0.00806, PR-AUC 0.906->0.949, ECE 0.013->0.008). Improvement is stable across 2022 (0.00709) and 2023 (0.00904) and across all regions (TN/MH/KA). th_accel is the top contributing new feature.

dry_spell.hyperparameters: two-state Markov P(y_t|y_{t-1}) from train; dseason==1 uses climatology
dry_spell.rationale: No ML or representation (groups A-E) beat frozen persistence on validation (best ML A/xgb 0.07870, B/xgb 0.07679). Keep frozen reference.

group_f_selection_summary: Group F not constructed: only temporal features (B) improved one target (revival); seasonal/event-state/spatial added no reliable validation value for any target. Combining groups would add complexity without evidence (H8.1).
